gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi reads clean and modern, with daylight inside every curve and lowercase that sits close to capital height. Megrim's hairline strokes give the pair its single strongest quality: a precise, wiry look.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mono:

gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mro: Futuristic and angular, Megrim draws each stroke like bent wire. Noto Sans Mro follows with dense, tall-bodied words and wide entrances into each letter, so a long passage reads sturdy and unhurried.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-multani:

gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-myanmar:

gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall, with wide-open s curves. Noto Sans Nabataean against Megrim's angular, matched horizontals and verticals gives the pair its strongest quality: a crisp, futuristic frame around a sturdy body.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Megrim brings angular, futuristic lines drawn at one unvarying weight. Noto Sans Nag Mundari answers with c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, and lowercase rivaling the capitals, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads friendly and unfussy, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Noto Sans Nandinagari sits under Megrim's angular crossbars, which match its stems, so the page moves from sharp futurism into generous openness.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-newa: Megrim builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, angular and futuristic. Noto Sans Newa follows with tall lowercase bowls and a clearly open e, giving the page a crisp top and a roomy body.
